# Docspec index (auto-generated)

Read first. One line per docspec: where its documentation lives
and the corpus artifacts and code paths it references. A
documentation sprint reads the references to find the
documentation a change reaches, and the lint reads each
`in code:` row to learn which files may carry doc comments. Read
`docspec/<slug>.md` for the full docspec. Generated by
`.ok-planner/bin/catalog-toc` and regenerated whenever a docspec delta
touches this collection. Do not edit by hand — changes will be
overwritten.
